reason: Expert points out that a port-channel readd workaround for LACP bundle issues only applies to firmware 7.4 and later, which failed on the older version.

knowledge.summary: Re-adding port channel members does not fix LACP bundle down issues on aggregation routers running firmware below 7.4.
knowledge.author: Antti Aalto
knowledge.details: Observed on firmware 7.4 for fixed units, but failed on version 7.2.0.
